title: EU AML Regulation (AMLR) for crypto-asset service providers | Customer Due Diligence Guide
summary: What the EU AMLR and AMLA draft standards mean for CASP onboarding: CDD thresholds, linked transactions, eIDs and the EUDI Wallet from July 2027.
body_markdown:
*What the EU AMLR and AMLA's final draft standards mean for CASP onboarding from 10 July 2027.*


From 10 July 2027, crypto-asset service providers (CASPs) apply the EU Anti-Money Laundering Regulation (AMLR) directly. A CASP must apply customer due diligence to every business relationship and to occasional transactions from EUR 1,000, and at least identify and verify the customer below that amount. Under AMLA's final draft standards, remote verification is expected to use suitable eIDs, including the EU Digital Identity Wallet (EUDI Wallet), or relevant qualified trust services wherever possible.


*Written by Aleksander Wasiak (Compliance Officer) and Daniel Heffernan (Crypto Market Lead), Authologic.*
